column1:

column1:
"I have seen countless battles. I know war! The taste of defeat... The taste of victory! But in this war... everything is at stake. So yes, those you speak of will know my blade. I will do whatever I must!"

column1: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."
column2: 傳說："In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."

column1:
"Kelari, you deceiver! I fell for your words, but no longer. Your sentence is a fate too good for you! I would give anything to bring back those who fell to your lies. Instead... I mourn my choices."

Navira lambasted Kelari a final time.
column2:

column1:
"Knowing where and when to plunge your knife is more important than the sharpness of your blade. I will not forget my error... and I will be a living example of your wisdom, dear <i>{Sekhema}."

Kelari accepted Varashta's sentence and committed himself to her.
column2:

column1:
"Listen not to his simpering words. He means to languish before you to weaken your resolve! He is duplicitous. An assassin, thriving on deception and lies. His lust for power is what drove his choice!"

Outrage trembled in Ruzhan's voice at the sentencing.
column2:

column1:
"My heart was fractured. I believed Kelari's words. I knew not his true nature... his ambition. I convinced Ruzhan there were cowards among his ranks. I failed you. And I accept my fate."

Navira confessed her failure to Varashta.

column1:
"The snare was set on our fallen. Beetles burst from their flesh, flooding the sands. Their exploding carapaces halted the advancing enemy... but it was not enough. And for that... I grieve."

Kelari admitted his wrongdoing to Varashta.
column2:

column1:
"Wipe the tears from your face, dear Navira. I did not deceive you. I meant every word. I will forever cherish you, my beloved. Know that I did it all for you... for our future!"

Kelari pleaded with the Tale-woman.

column1:

column1:

column1: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.
column2: 訓練有素的心靈孕育有序的思想。

column1: A throne is the most devious trap of them all
column2: 王座是所有陷阱中最陰險的一個。

column1:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.
column2:
傳說：A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

column1: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
column2: 萬事皆需平衡，魔法領域尤其如此。

column1: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.
column2: 戰鬥中鑄成的紐帶勝過血緣。

column1: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.
column2: 燃燒靈魂，以活化血肉。

column1: Each nick and cut brings death one step closer.
column2: 每一道傷口都讓死亡更近一步。

column1:
Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
column2:
傳說：Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.

column1: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
column2: 為追求偉大捨棄一切，甚至生命本身。

column1: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
column2: 偉大的戰術家明白，穩定往往勝過潛力。

column1: Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.
column2: 希望是錯誤。痛苦才是唯一真理。

column1: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
column2: 我給予你們一切，我的寵物們。別讓我失望。

column1: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
column2: 戰鬥中，確定性值得付出些許痛苦。

column1: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
column2: 割開血脈，從灑落的生命中汲取力量。

column1:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.
column2:
傳說：Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.

column1:
My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
column2:
傳說：My ancestral pact was sealed. Forevermore, I would gain sustenance
only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.

column1: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.
column2: 心跳漏拍，屏住呼吸。毒太慢時，唯有死亡。

column1:
Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.
column2:
傳說：Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.

column1: Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.
column2: 力量帶來敬畏。沒有比這更簡單的法則。

column1: Tear my flesh and splinter my bones. You will never break my spirit.
column2: 撕裂我的血肉，粉碎我的骨骼。你永遠無法折斷我的意志。

column1: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.
column2: 身體是一件等待被掌握的武器。

column1: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.
column2: 人數越少，需要分享的就越少。

column1: The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.
column2: 荒野不可遏止的靈魂在你體內燃燒，咆哮著渴望釋放。

column1: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.
column2: 音符或許改變，旋律始終如一。

column1: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.
column2: 泰坦並未從世界消失。他們的偉力仍在你體內延續。

column1:
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...
column2:
傳說：The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves.
With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...

column1: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!
column2: 到我身邊來，勇敢的同伴！感受我的光輝流經你們！

column1: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.
column2: 對防禦的絕對信任會釋放終極潛能。

column1:
What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?
column2:
傳說：What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?

column1: While the mind endures, so too will the body.
column2: 只要心智堅持，身體亦會支撐。

column1: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?
column2: 我為何要閃避我並不畏懼的打擊？

column1: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.
column2: 你懷著敵意繞行黑蠍，一次又一次挑釁它。

column1: Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
column2: 你的孫輩會因我今日所言的記憶而尖叫著醒來。
